name: Enoki Yuusaku
source:
The protagonist. He's a college boy who lives alone. He's very smart and can easily teach others. After becoming [url=http://vndb.org/c11686]Miina's[/url] boyfriend the two begin living together with the permission of [url=http://vndb.org/c11695]Miina's mother[/url] because Miina is too young for him to marry. They must keep their relationship a secret though her close friends already know.

He is best friends of [url=http://vndb.org/c11694]Kentarou[/url] and attends an English club at his college.
